quoted_tweet.text:
To win in modern advertising, you need to think like a con artist.

No, I don't mean that you should break any laws!

I mean, you need to be a chameleon.

You need to know how to blend into your surroundings.

If you fail, your audience will know and you'll stand out for the wrong reasons, getting ignored/skipped by users' subconscious ad blockers.

I actually think of advertising as pulling off an elaborate cognitive heist.

You're bypassing filters, borrowing trust, and guiding perception without resistance.

Oceans 11
Catch Me If You Can
American Hustle
Matchstick Men

These movies feature heists/cons and focus on the nuance of looking and feeling the part to sneak past people unsuspected, earn people's trust, and get away with it all. 

Study them to understand how and why the small details can matter to your audience.

Your ability to be a con artist or chameleon can be what makes or breaks your ads.

tweets.text:
ppl ask why i like paid ads so much.

here's my thoughts.

i've been in IM since 2018.

there are ppl a lot smarter than me, a lot more experienced than me.

but i do know this.

i know organic is powerful.

i know emails are powerful.

i know JVs are powerful.

HOWEVER.

paid ads are the most difficult game you can play.

there's a lot of ppl on here like copywriters etc saying i made this offer $100k+, $1m+...

then you ask about the traffic...

and it's all JV traffic.

organic.

email list.

thats too easy.

i don't even count it.

if you have the most elementary understanding of DR you can convert warm traffic.

for me...

I want to compete at the highest, most difficult, most competitive level.

ice cold traffic.

verrrrry few people are able to crack cold ads at scale.

scale being let's say 100k+ per day.

bc with cold paid ads...

nobody knows you.

nobody knows your product.

nobody knows your offer.

in fact...

most of them probably hate you as soon as they realize it's an ad and not a video of an OF girl shaking her ass.

and in a short period of time...

you have to convice those random people to give you their credit card info.

oftentimes in less than 60 minutes.

that, is fcking hard.

then you add the scale piece.

maybe you can do it at $500 a day in spend.

how about 1k.

how about 10k.

100k.

it gets infinitely more difficult.

(without being BH ofc)

to me...

paid ads is the endgame.

its where the savages play.

and most who play will lose.

but that's why I love playing it.

bc once you do crack it.

it's beautiful.

like poetry.

run more ads.
